Fine, low ripples drift slowly and evenly across the whole lake from left to right for the entire clip, and the mirror reflection of the mountains wavers softly in them while keeping its shape, colour and brightness. The sky, the mountains and the light stay exactly as they are, with no haze, mist or fading; the yellow scooter stays perfectly still and shows no badge or plate; the pebbled shore stays still. Nothing touches or breaks the water: no rings, splashes or drops. One uninterrupted shot; the ripples keep moving all the way through, and the first and last frames match the supplied image. No cuts, flashes, lightning, bursts, sparkles toward the camera, whole-frame flicker, exposure or contrast change; nothing flickers faster than twice a second. No people, figures, riders, faces, hands, text, letters, symbols, logos or new objects appear. No audio.
